sections.title: Authentication Provider
sections.description: AegisCore owns the temporary OAuth device session. Tokens stay in memory and are never rendered.

fields.label: Content Pack
fields.description: Content pack whose declared authentication provider should be used.

fields.label: Session Status
fields.description: Refresh after approving the device code through the authentication provider.

fields.label: Approval URL
fields.description: Open this link to complete the provider login and approve the current device session.

fields.label: Start Login
fields.description: Creates a short-lived device authorization request.

fields.label: Refresh Login
fields.description: Checks whether the provider approved the device request.

fields.label: Forget Local Session
fields.description: Removes the memory-only Aegis session from this process.
